mechanism: Oxybutynin is extensively metabolized by CYP3A4 and may compete for renal clearance with tenofovir; both drugs can affect renal function independently, requiring monitoring of overall kidney status.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) regularly during concurrent use and assess for anticholinergic side effects; adjust oxybutynin dosage if renal impairment develops.
